steps.content: You jolt up from the darkness.
Warm, humid steam fills your nostrils, carrying the scent of wax. You look down at your intact body, then glance around at the peaceful surroundings. You've returned to the hot spring inn.
Recalling the previous chaos sends a chill of dread through your body. What concerns you more is that hourglass. It's definitely not an ordinary prop, but more like... an Aurum Secretum weapon?

Assuming everything was just part of the hyper-realistic immersive experience, you lowered your guard against Mania. You thought everything was exceptionally produced, and the actors were just that good at their roles. Now you realize, none of that was acting, probably since the very beginning!
This is undoubtedly a Mania incident with a Sinner behind it. A-Class? No. With this level of concealment, enough to deceive even you, it must be an S-Class Sinner.
You've dealt with similar situations before and can't just ignore this one. If Mania goes unchecked, everyone here will become victims... You must find a way to leave and alert the MBCC.
